bullets.text: Tech Leaders Dine with Trump - **Tim Cook**, **Sam Altman**, and other tech giants attended a state banquet in the UK.
Teen Hacker Charged - A British teenager faces charges for over 120 cyberattacks, including extortion of US companies.
Google Tackles Revenge Porn - **Google** partners with UK nonprofit to combat nonconsensual intimate images on Search.
Notion Unveils AI Agents - **Notion** launches AI agents for enhanced data analysis and task automation.
Apple Music Import Tool Global - **Apple** rolls out its music import tool worldwide, easing transitions from other platforms.
iOS 26 Enhances Battery Management - New features in **iOS 26** help users manage battery drain effectively.
Apple Watch Ultra 3 Goes Satellite - The new **Apple Watch Ultra 3** includes satellite connectivity for emergency services.
AI Startups Boost Google Cloud - **Google Cloud** sees growth by partnering with AI startups like Lovable and Windsurf.
Huawei Competes with Nvidia - **Huawei** announces new AI infrastructure to enhance compute power amid Nvidia's challenges.
OpenAI Research on AI Deception - **OpenAI** explores how AI models can scheme and the challenges of training them.
